responsibility: This header declares the selftest-only concrete implementations of `diagnostic_event`, `diagnostic_thread`, and `diagnostic_path` used in GCC checking builds. It defines the `test_diagnostic_event`, `test_diagnostic_thread`, and `test_diagnostic_path` classes and their helpers for adding threads, generic events, call/entry/return path structure, and next-event connectivity, providing a tree-independent path model for diagnostics selftests.
same_name_distinction: Declares the selftest-only `test_diagnostic_event`, `test_diagnostic_thread`, and `test_diagnostic_path` classes and helper methods under `CHECKING_P`. In this same-name pair, the .cc contains their concrete implementations and formatting logic.
